name: campusguardian-ai
description: CampusGuardian AI - A Safer. Smarter. More Accessible Campus. (Hackathon Smart Campus Solution)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm --prefix server start" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm --prefix server start" "npm --prefix client run dev"
